ubergraph_probe_plain_literal_values.query: PREFIX oio: <http://www.geneontology.org/formats/oboInOwl#> SELECT ?u ?x WHERE { VALUES ?x { "ZFA:0001161" } ?u oio:hasDbXref ?x . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?u),"http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_")) }

ubergraph_probe_typed_literal_values.query: PREFIX oio: <http://www.geneontology.org/formats/oboInOwl#> SELECT ?u ?x WHERE { VALUES ?x { "ZFA:0001161"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string> } ?u oio:hasDbXref ?x . FILTER(STRSTARTS(STR(?u),"http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/UBERON_")) }
